questions.Description: Conducting  Tensile  test  on  mild  steel  /Deformed  bars  and  determining  yield strength and finding important parameters.
Conducting compression test and determining direct compressive strength on (i)wooden cube (ii)Brick/ Fly ash brick (iii) Masonry block (iv)Paver blocks (Any two shall be given in Examination).
Conducting double shear test on Mild steel bar and finding the shear value.
Conducting Torsion test on Steel bar and finding its Modulus of rigidity.
Conducting an Impact test on brittle and ductile material by performing Izod/Charpy tests.

Conducting Hardness test and finding Brinnel’s / Rockwell’s hardness number on
(i)Mild steel (ii)Brass (iii) Aluminium

Conducting deflection test on simply supported beams and finding its young’s
modulus value on (i)Wooden and (ii)Steel

Conducting fineness test on cement by Sieve analysis (OR) Blain’s Air
permeability apparatus.
Conduct Water absorption test on (i)Brick/Fly ash brick (ii) Coarse aggregates.
Determination of bulk density and Specific gravity of (i)Fine aggregate and (ii)Coarse aggregate.

Conducting attrition test on coarse aggregate by Deval’s (OR) Losangels
method.
Conducting abrasion test on aggregate by Dorry’s method.
Conducting Crushing test on coarse aggregate and finding the crushing value of aggregate.
Conducting Impact test on coarse aggregate and finding the impact value of the aggregates.

Determination of Elongation Index, Flakiness index and angularity index of
Aggregates.
